title: Camp Rules & Regulations
description:
## Camp Rules & Regulations

Welcome to **Refreshing 2026**. To ensure a spirit-filled, safe, and orderly camp experience for all delegates, please read and observe the following rules carefully.

---

### 1. Punctuality
- All sessions begin promptly as scheduled. Delegates are expected to be seated **5 minutes before** each session.
- Late arrivals should enter quietly and take available seats near the back to avoid disruption.

### 2. Dress Code
- Modest and decent dressing is mandatory throughout the camp.
- Female delegates: No revealing tops, miniskirts, or tight-fitting outfits.
- Male delegates: No sagging trousers, sleeveless vests in public areas, or inappropriate prints.
- Formal/smart casual attire is required for all plenary sessions.
- Casual wear is permitted during free periods only.

### 3. Lights Out & Rest Hours
- Lights out is at **11:00 PM** every night.
- Delegates must be in their designated hostel rooms by lights out.
- Noise must be kept to a minimum during rest hours (11 PM – 5 AM).

### 4. Movement & Security
- Delegates must not leave the camp premises without written permission from the Camp Coordinator.
- Movement within the camp after 10:30 PM requires a valid reason and must be communicated to hostel supervisors.
- All delegates must wear their camp ID at all times.

### 5. Electronic Devices
- Mobile phones must be on **silent mode** during all sessions and services.
- Recording of sessions (audio/video) is only permitted with prior authorization from the planning committee.
- Laptops and tablets may be used for note-taking during seminars.

### 6. Meals & Dining
- Meals are served at designated times in the dining hall only.
- No food or drinks (except water) are permitted in the chapel/auditorium.
- Delegates with dietary restrictions must notify the welfare team in advance.

### 7. Gender Boundaries
- Interaction between male and female delegates must be conducted with decorum and respect.
- Hostel blocks are strictly gender-segregated. Members of the opposite gender are not permitted in hostel rooms.

### 8. Conduct & Respect
- All delegates are expected to treat one another, camp officials, and facility staff with respect.
- Verbal abuse, harassment, or any form of misconduct will result in immediate disciplinary action.
- Disputes must be reported to a camp counsellor or committee member — not handled independently.

### 9. Spiritual Participation
- Full participation in all scheduled spiritual activities is expected of every delegate.
- Delegates are encouraged to come prepared: Bible, notepad, and a heart open to receive.

### 10. Emergencies
- In case of a medical emergency, contact the Camp Welfare Officer immediately.
- Do not self-medicate. Report all health concerns to the medical team on-site.
- Emergency contacts are posted on all hostel notice boards.

---

*Compliance with these rules is a condition of continued participation in Refreshing 2026. Any breach may result in warnings or removal from the camp programme at the discretion of the organizing committee.*
author: Refreshing 2026 Planning Committee

title: Holy, Holy, Holy (Hymn)
description:
## Holy, Holy, Holy
*Music: John B. Dykes | Words: Reginald Heber*

---

**Verse 1**
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessèd Trinity!

**Verse 2**
Holy, holy, holy! All the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee,
Which wert, and art, and evermore shalt be.

**Verse 3**
Holy, holy, holy! Though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see;
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

**Verse 4**
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thy Name, in earth, and sky, and sea;
Holy, holy, holy; merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessèd Trinity!
author: Reginald Heber

title: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name (Hymn)
description:
## All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
*Words: Edward Perronet | Music: Oliver Holden*

---

**Verse 1**
All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.

**Verse 2**
Ye chosen seed of Israel's race,
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.

**Verse 3**
Let every kindred, every tribe,
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.

**Verse 4**
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall!
We'll join the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.
We'll join the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.
author: Edward Perronet

title: Thou My Everlasting Portion (Close to Thee)
description:
## Thou My Everlasting Portion
*(Close to Thee)*
*Words: Fanny J. Crosby | Music: Silas J. Vail*

---

**Verse 1**
Thou my everlasting portion,
More than friend or life to me;
All along my pilgrim journey,
Savior, let me walk with Thee.

*Chorus:*
Close to Thee, close to Thee,
Close to Thee, close to Thee;
All along my pilgrim journey,
Savior, let me walk with Thee.

**Verse 2**
Not for ease or worldly pleasure,
Nor for fame my prayer shall be;
Gladly will I toil and suffer,
Only let me walk with Thee.

*Chorus*

**Verse 3**
Lead me through the vale of shadows,
Bear me o'er life's fitful sea;
Then the gate of life eternal
May I enter, Lord, with Thee.

*Chorus*
author: Fanny J. Crosby

title: Great Is Thy Faithfulness (Hymn)
description:
## Great Is Thy Faithfulness
*Words: Thomas O. Chisholm | Music: William M. Runyan*

---

**Verse 1**
Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father,
There is no shadow of turning with Thee;
Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not;
As Thou hast been Thou forever wilt be.

*Chorus:*
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see;
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided—
Great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

**Verse 2**
Summer and winter, and springtime and harvest,
Sun, moon and stars in their courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold witness
To Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

*Chorus*

**Verse 3**
Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth,
Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide;
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow,
Blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside!

*Chorus*
author: Thomas O. Chisholm
